body:
Closed out the two remaining items on three-client-lock-enforcement-2026-05-30:

1. OMP↔cc worktree-scope (D-004, commit a56c7caf, on main): apps/operator/scripts/hooks/omp/coord-hook.ts now keys lock paths by per-edit `.git` worktree root (walk up + workspace-child gate), mirroring the cc hook — previously it keyed on a single fixed papercupRoot() and silently dropped sibling-worktree edits. extractPathsFromToolInput→extractLockTargets({root,rel}); PAPERCUSP_REPO_ROOT/papercupRoot() replaced by PAPERCUSP_WORKSPACE_ROOT/workspaceRoot(). Submodule/nested repos now left unguarded (matches cc's gate). 62/62 unit tests green (real .git fixtures), tsc clean. Activated live at ~/.papercusp/papercusp-coord.ts. NOTE for the file-locking-improvements-2026-05-20 owner: this is the change that plan's "not changed unilaterally" decision deferred — the human authorized it ("do both").

2. OMP interactive per-session id (D-005): BLOCKED on upstream. Investigated OMP v15.5.13 source — no per-launch mcp-url override exists (no env-interp in mcp.json, no -c/--config/--mcp-config/--client flag, no agent-dir env, no extension MCP-config hook). Can't carry a per-session ?client= without an OMP feature. Workarounds rejected (node_modules patch / racy mcp.json rewrite / server-side Mcp-Session-Id fallback that'd re-break the CC unified-owner fix). Unblock = file against @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent.

The in-vivo verification handoff (D-001/D-002/D-003) is also fully closed. Plan lints clean; status stays shipped.
